text_block_list.text:
Seeing how exhausted Oguri Cap was, I 
decided to take her to the infirmary to 
rest.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. I'll take you up on 
your offer and rest.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Nn... *yaaawn*... I'm feeling drowsy now 
that I've eaten...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me... I think I'll just... sleep 
like this for a bit...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Where am I? I should have been at the 
academy...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? That statue of the Three 
Goddesses... Wait, no. It looks real."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"The big city really is amazing, they even 
have Goddesses. I gotta tell everyone back 
home... Hm?"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
She's waving her hand... Could it be she's 
telling me to chase after her?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No problem, I accept your challenge! Here 
I come, Three Goddesses...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Nnh...? Is this... the nurse's office? 
...I see, so I was dreaming.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That was fun... In the end, I couldn't 
catch up, but I didn't feel tired at all—I 
felt like I could run forever.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I feel so refreshed now. Taking a 
break was definitely worth it.

Her energy restored, Oguri Cap left the 
infirmary with a light step.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Gasp!? ...T-The infirmary? ...I see, it 
was just a dream.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...To think that mid-run, the Three 
Goddesses would turn into a giant pot of 
doteyaki...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Startled, I ended up taking a hard fall. 
*sigh*... I at least wanted to taste it 
before waking up.

Unable to forget the dote-ni stew from her 
dream, Oguri Cap couldn't calm down and 
get any rest...
